#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

ITEMS = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "bearing", "quantity": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "drive-belt", "quantity": 17},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            payload = {"status": "ok", "service": "inventory-api", "pid": os.getpid()}
            status = 200
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            payload = {"items": ITEMS, "count": len(ITEMS)}
            status = 200
        else:
            payload = {"error": "not found"}
            status = 404
        body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()

  code=$(curl --max-time 1 --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health" || true)
  [ "$state" = active ] && [ "$code" = 200 ] && break
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 1
done
printf 'recovery_utc='; date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
printf 'boot_id_after='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service='; systemctl is-active inventory-api.service
printf 'enabled='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-api.service
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-api.service)
printf 'pid=%s oom_score_adj=' "$pid"; cat "/proc/$pid/oom_score_adj"
printf 'health='; curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"; printf '\n'
printf 'inventory='; curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://$NODE_IP:8080/inventory"; printf '\n'
printf 'listener:\n'; ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 )'
printf 'current-boot-service-log:\n'; journalctl -b -u inventory-api.service --no-pager -n 10
